Op. 1048B16 PIPES AND/OR ELBOW BETWEEN TURBOCHARGER AND THROTTLE CASING - R.R.

1. Undo the upper fixing bolt (1a) and release the fuel pipes (1b) from the mounting bracket.

- Raise the vehicle.

1. Disconnect the band fastened to the turbocharger.

- Lower the vehicle.

2. Remove the rigid air supply pipe from the upper part of the engine compartment.

Refitting

Removing

- Fit the rigid air supply pipe via the upper part of the engine compartment.

- Raise the vehicle.

- Connect the band fastened to the turbocharger.

- Lower the vehicle.

- Tighten the upper fixing bolt and secure the fuel pipes to the mounting bracket.
